arxiv-2501-11666.description: Abstract Magnetic topological insulators (MTIs) host topologically protected edge states, but the role that these edge states play in electronic transport remains unclear. pmc-11398867.title: The bacterial quorum sensing signal 2’-aminoacetophenone rewires immune cell bioenergetics through the Ppargc1a/Esrra axis to mediate tolerance to infection
pmc-11398867.creator: Arijit Chakraborty, Arunava Bandyopadhaya, Vijay K Singh, Filip Kovacic, Sujin Cha, William M Oldham, A Aria Tzika, Laurence G Rahme, Bavesh D Kana, Arijit Chakraborty, Arunava Bandyopadhaya, Vijay K Singh, Filip Kovacic, Sujin Cha, William M Oldham, Aria A Tzika, Laurence G Rahme
pmc-11398867.description: How bacterial pathogens exploit host metabolism to promote immune tolerance and persist in infected hosts remains elusive. To achieve this, we show that Pseudomonas aeruginosa (PA), a recalcitrant pathogen, utilizes the quorum sensing (QS) signal 2’-aminoacetophenone (2-AA). Here, we unveil how 2-AA-driven immune tolerization causes distinct metabolic perturbations in murine macrophages’ mitochondrial respiration and bioenergetics.

Specifically, transmigration of inflammatory CD16+ monocytes through the altered blood brain barrier (BBB) may exacerbate cerebral small vessel disease (CSVD), a known cause of vascular cognitive impairment.

pmc-13375486.title: Characterization of global and regional left heart function using advanced echocardiography following intravenous administration of pimobendan in awake dogs
pmc-13375486.creator: Pierre Foulex, Valérie Chetboul, Emilie Moisset, Fany Roncin, Alona Dougère, Guillaume Noël, Emilie Tréhiou, Céline Pouzot-Nevoret, Valentin Bondoux, Mathieu Magnin

pmc-13589937.title: Lipid nanoparticles as active biointerfaces: From membrane interaction to systemic dysregulation
pmc-13589937.creator: Falko Seger, L. Maria Gutschi, Stephanie Seneff
pmc-13589937.description: Lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) are central to modern mRNA therapeutics, including COVID-19 vaccines. Far from passive carriers, their ionizable lipids actively interact with cellular membranes. Evidence from cellular, transcriptomic, and proteomic studies indicates that LNPs, with or without nucleic acid, alter gene and protein expression, thereby initiating inflammatory, detoxification, and stress responses at the membrane.

pmc-13660238.title: Rhizosheath is the key structural element for enhancing the drought resistance in alpine desertified grasslands of Kengyilia hirsuta
pmc-13660238.creator: Yutao Yuan, Xiaoxing Wei, Li Wu, Qingping Zhou, Jian Sun, Hui Wang, Chen Chen, Youjun Chen
pmc-13660238.description: Background and aimsTo cope with extreme drought of sandy grassland ecosystems, sand-adapted plants of Kengyilia hirsuta have evolved specialized functional traits for rhizosheath. The majority of studies ignore the natural process of drought-rewatering simulation and lack systematic research on regulatory mechanisms during rhizosheath formation, restricting understanding of the optimal adaptation strategy for sand-adapted plants.
